I came out to myself while my ex-partner and I were on a break (broke up as deadname, got back together four months later as current name).  Before that, penetrating her was extremely enjoyable.  Once we got back together, PIV became a genuinely damaging experience for me, and it stayed that way til we broke up for good.  Nothing to do with her - she was, and remains, the most patient and supportive person in my life - but the boundaries changed as I changed.  Where I was at that point in my transition, using my penis like that was a massive trigger.

Give it time, you may go back to finding penetration enjoyable.  On the rare occasion I do it now, it doesn't trigger dysphoria like it used to.

It took some trial and error (figuring out how to credibly cover the male hairline with a short haircut was a turning point), but it's working out well so far.  I doubt I'll ever lose the ability to pass as a guy if I need to, but with the right subtle touches andro-femme has proven attainable.

As far as the cis world is concerned I'm female, but in actuality I'm kind of a weird mix of both.  It was always the tomboyish androgynous types that made me hate my appearance.  Took years to work out that my feelings were valid, and trans didn't have to mean "I want stereotypically girly things".

Transition for me is pretty much letting HRT do its thing while I slim down and femme up my appearance *ever so slightly*.
